title: Six years of Sinatra recordings and tours; 41 takes of I've Got You Under My Skin
summary: Edison toured with Sinatra and describes his perfectionism, including 41 takes on one song.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: But we've had so much fun recording. So much fun. And I recorded with him for six years straight, you know. JUST -- we took trips, you know, Nelson did.

Oh, yeah, we went on tour with Sinatra, a lot of times. Down the Coast and we'd go to San Francisco, you know, the Cow Palace and places like that, LaJolla, we'd take trips all up and down, Phoenix, you know. Sometimes for a whole month, three or four nights a week, we'd be flying out to do dates. And it was just -- he's a lot of fun. I still record with him.
No, it wasn't hard. The hardest part about it was playing for him because he's a perfectionist. He likes everything just right. If it's not right, it's not going out, you know.
I remember we made this album he has, 'Got You Under My Skin,' which is one of the classics of all times, you know. We made 41 takes on that. 41 takes before he decided the right one. 41.
